The OSV record is misfiled against the core apache-airflow package. The Sqoop provider code is not present in this conda artifact and must be explicitly installed as a separate package.

The vulnerability is in the apache-airflow-providers-sqoop package, not in apache-airflow core. The airflow-with-cloudant package installs the Cloudant provider extras, not the Sqoop provider. The vulnerable Sqoop provider code is not present in this conda artifact.

The advisory explicitly states that Airflow 3 users are not affected. The latest conda-forge version of airflow-with-cloudant is 3.0.1. Additionally, the vulnerability requires the Edge3 provider to be installed and configured, which is not a dependency of the Cloudant extras this package provides. Even historical 1.x Airflow versions in the OSV range do not appear to be shipped by the conda-forge airflow-with-cloudant feedstock.
